name: design-flow
description: Run persistent, owner-authoritative design rounds from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Structure design questions, keep recommendations separate from owner decisions, preview drafts without authority, explicitly lock approved rounds, track unresolved work and provenance, and compile living documents and context handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Show unresolved questions in my Design Flow project.
Import this design round and preview it without locking.
Recommend the next design round, but do not start it.
